lines.en: label toukadorm25p1:
I knock on Touka’s door and don’t have anything creative to say about it.
lines.zh: 我敲开 Touka 的门，想不出什么有创意的开场白。

lines.en: So I decide to knock a second time just to make things slightly more interesting.
lines.zh: 于是我又敲了一次，好让事情稍微有意思点。

lines.en: : Come in?
lines.zh: : 请进？

lines.en: scene black
I save my third knock for when my creativity fully dies and Touka will no longer let me into her room.
lines.zh: 我把第三次敲门留给「我的创意彻底枯竭、Touka 再也不放我进她房间」的那一天。

lines.en: At this rate, something like that could happen any day.
lines.zh: 照这势头，那一天说不定哪天就到。

lines.en: scene toukawalk1
Because, while the two of us can have serious conversations on occasion (Normally while I’m interrupting her morning practices), she’s still {i}Touka{/i} at the end of the day.
lines.zh: 因为，尽管我俩偶尔也能进行严肃的谈话（通常是趁她晨练时被我打断），但她终究还是 {i}Touka{/i}。

lines.en: She’s not on the same level as everyone else and, even if she {i}does{/i} like (or tolerate) me now, that could change at any given moment.
lines.zh: 她跟别人不在一个层面上。就算她现在喜欢我（或至少容忍我），那也随时可能变。

lines.en: Her family will always come first because that’s just...the type of family she’s from.
lines.zh: 她的家族永远排第一，因为她就是……那种家庭出身的人。

lines.en: And no matter what I do (or want to do) to her, nothing will change that.
lines.zh: 而且不管我对她做什么（或想做什么），都改变不了这一点。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: : I believe this is the part where I’m supposed to act surprised by your arrival, but your impatience reared its head at the door and I was able to realize it was you a bit earlier than normal today.
lines.zh: : 我想这会儿我该对你的到来表现出惊讶，可你在门口就沉不住气了，所以我今天比平常更早意识到是你。

lines.en: : Good day to you as well, madam.
lines.zh: : 也祝你今天愉快，夫人。

lines.en: : Why are you all dressed up? It’s been a while since I’ve seen you in that outfit.
lines.zh: : 你怎么穿得这么正式？我有阵子没见你穿这身了。

lines.en: scene toukawalk2
: I abstain from wearing it around the city as I’ve come to realize it’s a bit too {i}lavish{/i} to be perceived as “normal.” Plus, dressing in commoner-attire prevents me from being attacked.
lines.zh: : 我在城里不穿它，因为我渐渐意识到它{i}奢华{/i}得有点过分、没法被当成「正常」。再说，穿平民的衣服能避免我被人袭击。

lines.en: : This dress is worth more than your home and I’d prefer it remains both {i}on{/i} my body and {i}out{/i} of the wrong person’s hands.
lines.zh: : 这条裙子比你的房子还贵，我希望它既留{i}在我身上{/i}，也别落到{i}坏人手里{/i}。

lines.en: : So what I’m hearing is the “right” person would be able to get their hands on said body so long as you remain clothed.
lines.zh: : 所以我听到的意思是——只要你还穿着衣服，「对的人」就能碰到这具身体。

lines.en: : Of course that’s what you’re hearing. You are a pervert. And to that I say- please back away. I am carrying mace.
lines.zh: : 你当然会听出这个意思。你是个色鬼。对此我要说——离我远点。我带了防狼喷雾。

lines.en: : Will do. But you still haven’t told me what the occasion is.
lines.zh: : 会的。可你还没告诉我今天是什么场合。

lines.en: scene toukawalk3
: I must not have received the memo advising me that I must inform you of my every action. Please forgive me.
lines.zh: : 我大概没收到那份「必须向你汇报我的一举一动」的通知。请原谅我。

lines.en: : It’s okay, you’re forgiven. What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 没事，原谅你了。到底怎么了？

lines.en: : Do I need to send a second memo?
lines.zh: : 需要我再发一份通知吗？

lines.en: scene toukawalk4
: I’m on my way to the manor to take care of some business with my mother. And I {i}intended{/i} to go there alone, but I now feel pressured to invite you on account of how “clingy” you are tonight.
lines.zh: : 我正要去大宅跟我母亲处理点事。{i}本来打算{/i}一个人去，可看你今晚这么「黏人」，我只好勉强邀你同行。

lines.en: : I’m not clingy. I just miss you and appreciate all you do for both the class and me.
lines.zh: : 我不黏人。我只是想你，也感激你为班级和我做的一切。

lines.en: scene toukawalk5
: You absolutely do not. But I will allow you to come regardless. I do ask that you remain on your best behavior, though. From what I understand, this is going to be a serious meeting.
lines.zh: : 你绝对没有。不过我反正还是让你来。但我要求你拿出最好的表现。据我所知，这将是场严肃的会面。

lines.en: : Serious? You don’t think it’s about the apartment complex, do you?
lines.zh: : 严肃？你该不会觉得跟公寓楼有关吧？

lines.en: scene toukawalk6
: I do not. Because, and brace yourself for this, Sensei- the world does not revolve around you. The Tsukioka Foundation has much more to worry about than some trivial side project I took up.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得。因为——你做好心理准备，Sensei——世界不是围着你转的。月冈财团要操心的事，比我搞的那点微不足道的副业多得多。

lines.en: : The world doesn’t revolve around your family either. Which is why you should all surrender your wealth to me and let me take up the mantle as the new Tsukioka figurehead.
lines.zh: : 世界也不是围着你家转的。所以你们不如把财富都交给我，让我当新一任月冈家的家主。

lines.en: scene toukawalk5
: If you’re going to propose, at least do it in a proper, less self-absorbed way. Of course I won’t say yes to that.
lines.zh: : 你要是想「求婚」，好歹用个体面点、别这么自我中心的方式。那种我当然要拒绝。

lines.en: : You’re sure it’s cool if I come with you? I don’t want to interrupt whatever “important business” you have going on. Especially now that I know it’s business that doesn’t directly pertain to me.
lines.zh: : 你确定让我跟着没问题？我不想打扰你的「要事」。尤其现在我知道这事跟我没直接关系了。

lines.en: scene toukawalk2
: I’m sure it will be fine. The worst case scenario is that you’ll be forced to wait out the night in a private room while I take care of whatever it is that needs to be done.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定没事。最坏的情况无非是你得在一间单独的房间里过夜，等我把该办的事办完。

lines.en: : But it would be less like “solitary confinement” and more like being sequestered in a three-star Holiday Inn Express.
lines.zh: : 但那与其说是「单独监禁」，不如说是被安顿在一家三星级智选假日酒店。

lines.en: scene toukawalk7
This message has been brought to you in part by Holiday Inn Express.
lines.zh: 本消息部分由智选假日酒店赞助播出。

lines.en: At Holiday Inn Express hotels, we keep it simple...and smart.
lines.zh: 在智选假日酒店，我们一切从简……且明智。

lines.en: Book your stay today.
lines.zh: 今天就预订您的下榻。

lines.en: scene toukawalk2
: That doesn’t sound so bad. I’ve always wanted to stay in a Holiday Inn Express.
lines.zh: : 听着倒不坏。我一直想住一次智选假日酒店。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because they keep it simple and smart.
lines.zh: : 因为他们一切从简且明智。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, okay. I suppose this works out quite well then.
lines.zh: : 哦。那好吧。看来这事安排得还挺合适。

lines.en: scene black
: We mustn’t delay any further, though. My limousine is already waiting outside.
lines.zh: : 不过我们不能再耽搁了。我的豪华轿车已经在外面等着了。

lines.en: : If you’d please follow me, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 请跟我来，Sensei……

lines.en: Touka reaches out her hand to guide me but, when I attempt to grab it, she takes it back and makes me look like an idiot.
lines.zh: Touka 伸出手来引路，可等我去抓，她又把手收回去，让我像个傻子。

lines.en: I have no idea who taught her this, but my newest goal in life is to find them and eliminate them.
lines.zh: 我不知道这是谁教她的，但我最新的人生目标就是找出那个人、然后做掉他。

lines.en: Or, if it is someone I am actively having sex with (Which is very possible from a sheer mathematic point of view), to eliminate them in a {i}different{/i} way.
lines.zh: 或者——如果那是我正在上床的某个人（纯从概率看这很有可能）——就用{i}另一种{/i}方式「做掉」她。

lines.en: With my penis.
lines.zh: 用我的阴茎。

lines.en: What I mean is that I’m going to have really violent sex with them.
lines.zh: 我的意思是，我要跟对方进行非常激烈的性爱。

lines.en: But anyway, Touka and I hop into the limo and, after a smooth and quiet ride over to the manor, we begin to make our way through an area that is becoming rather familiar to me.
lines.zh: 总之，Touka 和我坐进豪车，一路平稳安静地到了大宅，开始穿过一片我渐渐熟悉起来的区域。

lines.en: scene toukawalk8
How that happened is still a little strange but, then again, what isn’t nowadays?
lines.zh: 这事怎么发生的还是有点怪，不过话说回来，这年头还有什么不怪？

lines.en: If you told me two years ago that I’d one day be memorizing the layout of a rich girl’s mansion, I probably would have assumed your name was Ayane and then asked you to stop speaking with my dick in your mouth.
lines.zh: 两年前你要是跟我说，我将来会把一个富家女大宅的布局背下来，我多半会以为你叫 Ayane，然后叫你别含着我说话。

lines.en: But that’s not the case at all. In fact, my dick rarely finds its way into Ayane’s mouth at all anymore because we’re either too busy having real sex like human beings or learning things about the end of the world.
lines.zh: 但事实根本不是那样。其实我的鸡巴现在很少再进 Ayane 的嘴了——因为我们要么忙着像正常人一样做爱，要么忙着了解世界末日的内情。

lines.en: I wonder for a moment how long it will be before Touka makes it to that point.
lines.zh: 我一时好奇，还要多久 Touka 才会走到那一步。

lines.en: Not the sex part — the latter. But of course, I wholeheartedly welcome the idea of having sex with her prior to that.
lines.zh: 不是指上床——是指后者。不过当然，在那之前能跟她上床，我求之不得。

lines.en: And with the way she smiles at me sometimes, I feel as if that’s not all that far away.
lines.zh: 而且看她有时对我笑的样子，我觉得那天不远了。

lines.en: I know it’s just politeness, though.
lines.zh: 可我知道那只是礼貌。

lines.en: I know this is how she was raised.
lines.zh: 我知道她就是这么被养大的。

lines.en: I know there must have been countless men and women before me who were shown this same exact smile in this same exact dress.
lines.zh: 我知道在我之前，肯定有无数男男女女见过这同样的笑容、这同样的裙子。

lines.en: And I know it always went nowhere.
lines.zh: 我也知道那从来没结果。

lines.en: But that doesn’t stop me from wanting to be an outlier.
lines.zh: 但这拦不住我想当那个例外。

lines.en: And it can not quell the incessant fantasies of tearing that dress off of her.
lines.zh: 也压不住我那一刻不停的、想把那条裙子从她身上撕下来的幻想。

lines.en: : You’re thinking something inappropriate, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你在想些不正经的事，对吧？

lines.en: : Me? Never.
lines.zh: : 我？没有。

lines.en: scene toukawalk9
: Perhaps I should just sequester you now and save myself the mace?
lines.zh: : 也许我现在就该把你「隔离」起来，省得我费防狼喷雾？

lines.en: : Yeah...that would probably be best for everyone.
lines.zh: : 是啊……那样对大家都好。

lines.en: : You really are like a child sometimes, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你有时候真像个孩子，Sensei。

lines.en: scene toukawalk10
: Meanwhile, I have a hard time believing you {i}ever{/i} acted like a child. At least not in this setting. The real world is another story entirely.
lines.zh: : 与此同时，我很难想象你也{i}有过{/i}「像个孩子」的时候。至少在这种环境里不可能。外面的世界就是另一回事了。

lines.en: : I’m getting there. But you’re not far off in your assumption of how I was at home.
lines.zh: : 我快变成了。不过你猜我在家里什么样，基本没猜错。

lines.en: scene toukawalk11
: For as long as I can remember, I’ve been showered with praise. For my behavior...My talent...My understanding of the role that I was born into.
lines.zh: : 打我记事起，我就一直被赞美包围。为我的举止……为我的才华……为我对「自己生来该扮演的角色」的理解。

lines.en: : But of course, such praise was not simply gifted to me. Everything I {i}was{/i} and everything I {i}am{/i} was earned.
lines.zh: : 但当然，这些赞美不是白给的。我{i}过去{/i}的一切、{i}现在{/i}的一切，都是挣来的。

lines.en: : I lost count of how many different lessons I’ve taken over the years. And for things that won’t even matter, no less.
lines.zh: : 我数不清这些年上了多少种课。而且还是些根本无关紧要的东西。

lines.en: : How to hold a fork. How to play piano. The {i}names{/i} of different {i}types{/i} of forks. French. The {i}position{/i} forks need to be placed in.
lines.zh: : 怎么拿叉子。怎么弹钢琴。{i}各种{/i}叉子的{i}名称{/i}。法语。叉子该摆在什么{i}位置{/i}。

lines.en: scene toukawalk12
: There were so many lessons about forks! Why?!
lines.zh: : 关于叉子的课居然有那么多！凭什么？！

lines.en: : Being rich sounds weird.
lines.zh: : 当有钱人听着真怪。

lines.en: scene toukawalk13
: It is so incredibly strange at times. Especially in hindsight. And I sometimes find myself envying my sister as her schedule is significantly less packed than mine was at her age.
lines.zh: : 有时候确实怪到不行。尤其事后回想。我有时会羡慕我妹妹——她的日程比我在她那个年纪时空得多。

lines.en: scene toukawalk11
: But again, this was the role that I was born into. And as the eldest daughter of Tomonori and Tsubasa Tsukioka, there are certain things expected of me.
lines.zh: : 但再说一次，这是我生来该扮演的角色。作为 Tomonori 和 Tsubasa Tsukioka 的长女，有些事是注定要我去做的。

lines.en: : I suppose you could even say I lack the freedom to discover who I am on my own as it was already predetermined the moment I entered this world.
lines.zh: : 你甚至可以说，我没有「自己去发现我是谁」的自由——因为早在我来到这世界的那一刻，一切就已注定。

lines.en: : And yet...I do not hate it.
lines.zh: : 然而……我并不讨厌它。

lines.en: : You don’t?
lines.zh: : 你不讨厌？

lines.en: : I don’t.
lines.zh: : 不讨厌。

lines.en: scene toukawalk14
: Perhaps it’s due to my future being figuratively beaten into me since I was young, but I never fancied or even...I suppose {i}comprehended{/i} any other sort of life.
lines.zh: : 也许是因为，我的未来从小就被「比喻性地」打进了我的脑子里——我从没向往过、甚至……{i}理解{/i}过别种人生。

lines.en: : Without any idea of what I {i}could{/i} want, I was left to only want {i}one{/i} thing. And that thing is plastered to a slowly rising sun that will one day shine for me and no one else.
lines.zh: : 因为根本不知道自己还{i}能{/i}想要什么，我便只剩下{i}一样{/i}东西可求。而那东西，被粘在一轮缓缓升起的太阳上——终有一天，它只会为我一个人发光。

lines.en: : As if it doesn’t shine for you already.
lines.zh: : 说得好像它现在没为你发光似的。

lines.en: scene toukawalk15
: I understand why you’d say that. To you and many others, it must seem that I already have everything I could ever want.
lines.zh: : 我理解你为什么这么说。在你和许多人看来，我大概已经拥有了我想要的一切。

lines.en: : But what can not be seen is my want for {i}wanting{/i} something.
lines.zh: : 但看不见的是：我渴望{i}「能有所渴望」{/i}。

lines.en: : What can not be seen is the cage that keeps me from taking flight.
lines.zh: : 看不见的是：那只拦着我起飞的笼子。

lines.en: : The most depressing part is that the door of that cage has been open this entire time. And I’ve been perfectly capable of leaving it.
lines.zh: : 最可悲的是，那笼子的门一直开着。而我完全有能力走出去。

lines.en: : But among a ruthless regime of fork-based lessons and lectures on etiquette, I was also taught that I {i}wanted{/i} to stay inside of that cage...so there was never a reason to leave at all.
lines.zh: : 可在那一套套残酷的「叉子课」和礼仪训诫之外，我还被教导：我{i}想{/i}留在笼子里……所以从来没有任何离开的理由。

lines.en: : And now, it’s so ingrained into the way I think that it’s as if I’ve inherited every last bit of my mother. And my father. And those who lived before me.
lines.zh: : 而现在，它已经深植进我的思维方式——仿佛我继承了我母亲的每一分、我父亲的每一分、以及先于我而活的所有人的每一分。

lines.en: : Decades and decades of customs and expectations and {i}rules{/i} flow through my blood like crocodiles in the Nile.
lines.zh: : 几十年又几十年的习俗、期待、{i}规矩{/i}，像尼罗河里的鳄鱼一样在我的血液里游动。

lines.en: : They’re simply a part of me now. They can not be removed, nor do I {i}want{/i} them to be. But I know their existence was not of my own choosing, which makes it all feel a bit false at times.
lines.zh: : 它们如今就是我的一部分。剜不掉，我也不{i}想{/i}剜。可我知道它们的存在不是我自己的选择，这让一切有时显得有点虚假。

lines.en: scene toukawalk14
: Nothing against crocodiles, of course. I’m sure they love their home just as much as I do.
lines.zh: : 当然，我对鳄鱼没有意见。我相信它们跟我一样热爱自己的家。

lines.en: : Isn’t it...boring, though? Already knowing your future?
lines.zh: : 不过……那样不无聊吗？早就知道自己的未来。

lines.en: scene toukawalk15
: It can be.
lines.zh: : 有时会。

lines.en: : But my life is not entirely devoid of excitement now that you and the others have nestled into it.
lines.zh: : 但如今你和大家都「栖身」进我的生活里，它也并非全无乐趣。

lines.en: scene black
Touka stops walking and I don’t notice right away.
lines.zh: Touka 停下脚步，我一开始没察觉。

lines.en: But when I turn around, she isn’t gazing up at the moon or...wistfully watching the stars and correlating them to some grand idea of how expansive the universe is.
lines.zh: 可当我回头，她没有在仰望月亮，也没有……怅然地望着星星、把它们跟「宇宙有多浩瀚」之类的宏大念头联系起来。

lines.en: She’s looking at me.
lines.zh: 她在看我。

lines.en: scene toukawalk16
She’s looking at something that stood beneath her cage and shouted catcalls at her until she was forced to leave it.
lines.zh: 她在看一个曾站在她笼下、冲她大喊大叫直到她被迫走出来的东西。

lines.en: And it wasn’t until she was outside that she realized just how expansive that universe really is.
lines.zh: 而直到走到笼子外，她才明白那个宇宙到底有多浩瀚。

lines.en: It wasn’t the stars at all.
lines.zh: 那根本不是星星。

lines.en: It was all of us.
lines.zh: 是我们所有人。

lines.en: : What? Why are you looking at me like that?
lines.zh: : 干嘛？你为什么那样看着我？

lines.en: : Like what?
lines.zh: : 哪样？

lines.en: : Like {i}that.{/i} Like you’re-
lines.zh: : 就{i}那样{/i}。像你——

lines.en: : My mother?
lines.zh: : 像我母亲？

lines.en: scene toukawalk17
: Ahh...you really have been spending more time with her lately, haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 啊……你最近确实跟她待得更多了，是吧？

lines.en: scene toukawalk18
: Should I be worried?
lines.zh: : 我该担心吗？

lines.en: : What would you have to worry about?
lines.zh: : 你有什么好担心的？

lines.en: : That you’ll see just how...{i}unoriginal{/i} I am.
lines.zh: : 担心你会发现我有多……{i}没创意{/i}。

lines.en: : I mean...don’t get me wrong. You two clearly have a lot in common. But there’s plenty I’ve seen in you that I’ve yet to see in her.
lines.zh: : 我是说……别误会。你们俩显然有很多共同点。但我在你身上看到的很多东西，在她身上还没看到。

lines.en: : I’m assuming those sample sizes are rather skewed in my favor, though. And I wonder if you’ll say the same when you come to know her just as well.
lines.zh: : 不过我猜，这两份「样本量」可能对我有利。我好奇，等你同样了解她之后，还会不会这么说。

lines.en: : I doubt Tsubasa is the type to {i}let{/i} anyone know her that well.
lines.zh: : 我很怀疑 Tsubasa 是那种会{i}让{/i}人「那么了解她」的人。

lines.en: : And I am?
lines.zh: : 而我是？

lines.en: : So far. You might also be capable of sly, behind-the-scenes manipulation- but you’ll need way more practice if you’re ever going to get to her level.
lines.zh: : 目前是。你也许也有搞「幕后操纵」的潜质——但你要想到她那个水平，还得多练。

lines.en: scene toukawalk19
: You know her better than I thought.
lines.zh: : 你比我想的更了解她。

lines.en: : Her intentions are good, though. And I trust her judgement entirely.
lines.zh: : 不过她的本意是好的。而且我完全信任她的判断。

lines.en: : It {i}does{/i} seem that way most of the time. The way she goes about things just makes me feel a little weird. Like I’m the sidekick to the world’s most lawfully good vigilante or something.
lines.zh: : 大多数时候{i}确实{/i}是这样。只是她做事的方式让我有点别扭。好像我是「世上最守法的正义义警」身边的跟班似的。

lines.en: : Hmm...I’m not sure if you’re fit to be her “sidekick” just yet.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不确定你现在够不够格当她的「跟班」。

lines.en: : But I wouldn’t mind you being mine.
lines.zh: : 但我不介意你当我的。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? And what would my duties include? Making sure you don’t have any sort of original thought? Filtering all your opinions through your mother and trying to get them approved?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？那我的职责包括什么？确保你不产生任何原创想法？把你所有观点先过你母亲那关、求她批准？

lines.en: : Ha ha ha. Clever. But I’ll have you know that sharing the same values and ideals as her does not make me a complete clone. I’m still Touka Tsukioka when all is said and done.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。机智。但告诉你：跟她有相同的价值观和理想，不代表我是她的彻头彻尾的克隆。说到底，我还是 Touka Tsukioka。

lines.en: : Until your corporate robo-family asks you to be something else.
lines.zh: : 直到你那「企业机器人家庭」要求你变成别的什么。

lines.en: : They will not ask. They will {i}expect.{/i} And I will likely do as they want as that is how I was grown.
lines.zh: : 他们不会「要求」。他们会{i}「期待」{/i}。而我多半会照做，因为我就是被这样「培育」出来的。

lines.en: : With the one exception being an arranged marriage?
lines.zh: : 唯一的例外是包办婚姻？

lines.en: scene toukawalk20
: I...beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 你……说什么？

lines.en: : Your mom told me a while ago that they had several “suitors” picked out for you, but that you never seemed comfortable with the idea.
lines.zh: : 你妈前阵子告诉我，他们给你挑好了几个「追求者」，可你一直对这主意不太自在。

lines.en: scene toukawalk21
: Why on earth would she tell you that? How did that topic even come up?
lines.zh: : 她到底为什么会告诉你这个？那话题是怎么聊起来的？

lines.en: : No clue. But if you’re so dead set on playing the role, why was that an issue?
lines.zh: : 不知道。不过你要真那么铁了心「扮演角色」，那事怎么会成问题？

lines.en: scene toukawalk22
: Hah...
: It wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 它不是问题。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: scene toukawalk23
: I mean that I would have followed through with it if it needed to be done.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，如果非做不可，我会照办的。

lines.en: : As the family’s heir, it is my responsibility that we maintain our status once my parents pass away. And if joining families with another influential house would secure such a status, I would comply.
lines.zh: : 作为家族继承人，我有责任在父母过世后保住我们的地位。而如果跟另一个有影响力的家族联姻能保住这份地位，我会遵从。

lines.en: : Then why-
lines.zh: : 那为什么——

lines.en: : Because you do not always have to be “comfortable” with something to know that it must be done. That is especially true for people in power.
lines.zh: : 因为一个人不必非得对一件事「自在」，才知道它必须去做。对掌权者尤其如此。

lines.en: : If my family had always taken the “comfortable” path, we’d be nowhere near where we are today.
lines.zh: : 要是我家当初总走「自在」的那条路，就不会有今天。

lines.en: : So...what? You’d just let some random guy from another family knock you up for {i}status?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那……又怎样？你就任由别家随便一个男人为了{i}地位{/i}让你怀孕？

lines.en: : Would you rather it be you?
lines.zh: : 你宁愿那个人是你？

lines.en: : That...wait. No. That’s not what I was-
lines.zh: : 那……等等。不。我不是那个意思——

lines.en: scene toukawalk24
: As much as I appreciate my mother’s kindness and consideration, I would do whatever I believed to be best for my family.
lines.zh: : 尽管我感激母亲的善意和体贴，但凡是我认为对家族最有利的，我都会去做。

lines.en: scene toukawalk25
: But...thankfully...I don’t {i}have{/i} to.
lines.zh: : 不过……幸好……我{i}不用{/i}。

lines.en: : You see, there’s no one here who could elevate our family any further. At least not with the city closed-off. So I’m free to marry someone I love instead.
lines.zh: : 你看，这儿没人能让我们家更上一层楼——至少在城池封锁的当下没有。所以我可以自由地嫁给我爱的人。

lines.en: : I just wonder if I can ever find it in myself to do that.
lines.zh: : 我只是不知道，我到底有没有办法让自己去「爱」。

lines.en: scene toukawalk26
: To be completely honest, I’m not sure I’d make a very good wife in the first place. A mother, perhaps. But I’m not sure if I could tolerate someone like you pestering me all day, every day.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我不确定自己能不能当个好妻子。当个好母亲，或许行。但我不确定能不能容忍像你这样的人一天到晚缠着我。

lines.en: : It sounds fun, though. Right?
lines.zh: : 不过听着挺有意思的，对吧？

lines.en: scene toukawalk27
: {i}Fun?{/i} Please. That sounds like the single most exhausting thing I’ve ever heard of.
lines.zh: : {i}有意思{/i}？得了吧。那听着是我听过最累人的事。

lines.en: : And that’s not even counting what we’d get up to at {i}night.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这还没算上我们{i}晚上{/i}会干的事呢。

lines.en: scene toukawalk28
: Are you sure I’m not a bit too {i}womanly{/i} for your tastes? What, with you fancying girls of {i}Maya’s{/i} stature and all.
lines.zh: : 你确定对你这种口味来说，我不会太{i}「女人」{/i}了点？毕竟你喜欢的是 {i}Maya{/i} 那种身材的。

lines.en: : That was...not a thing you were supposed to see.
lines.zh: : 那……不是你该看到的。

lines.en: scene toukawalk29
: But I did. And now I know, so ha.
lines.zh: : 可我看到了。现在我知道了，哼。

lines.en: : Touka...
lines.zh: : Touka……

lines.en: : Sensei, if you’re {i}that{/i} desperate to marry into the family, perhaps Tsukasa would be more in line with your...{i}tastes?{/i}
lines.zh: : Sensei，你要是{i}那么{/i}想「嫁进这个家」，也许 Tsukasa 更合你的……{i}口味{/i}？

lines.en: : Tsukasa? Just what kind of person do you think I am?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa？你到底把我当成什么人了？

lines.en: : Someone who should not be allowed within five miles of a school.
lines.zh: : 一个不该出现在学校五英里范围内的人。

lines.en: : Touka, I am not going to {i}marry{/i} Tsukasa. And I really wish you and your mom would stop trying to-
lines.zh: : Touka，我不会{i}娶{/i} Tsukasa。而且我真希望你和你妈别再想把我——

lines.en: : Peasant!
lines.zh: : 平民！

$ touka_love += 1
jump toukadorm25p2
